title: Discover Each Man's Thumbscrew
coreMove: Find the exact pressure point that moves this person instead of pushing with generic force
sourcePressure: Chapter 33 centers on leverage through specific pressure points rather than generic force. The law values finding a person's hidden craving, fear, vanity, dependency, or vulnerability because influence strengthens when it touches what actually moves that person. Its limit is that pressure-point thinking becomes brittle or abusive when it turns people into flat caricatures, ignores changing context, or crosses into cruelty for its own sake. Frozen sidecar provides no traceable named anecdote for this chapter; do not fabricate named source anchors.
